description: Progressively refine one-line feedback into a Behavior Note, finalized PBC, and downstream derivation seeds without multiplying product artifacts.

agent.description: Normalizes feedback, writes artifacts, runs pressure passes, and records evidence.

product_owner.description: Answers the single highest-leverage clarification or patch decision when needed.

states.description: Raw one-line feedback has landed but has not yet been normalized into a Behavior Note.
Feedback is normalized into a Behavior Note; the agent decides whether one clarification is needed before drafting.
Blocked on the product owner answering the single highest-leverage clarification question.
A compact PBC has been drafted and is ready for a pressure pass.
A pressure pass is being run against the draft PBC to test it for readiness, needed patches, or vagueness.
Blocked on the product owner deciding whether to finalize with the pressure patch or send the PBC back for revision.
Terminal success: the final PBC is accepted and downstream work/test/design seeds can be derived.
Terminal disposal: the feedback was closed without a finalized PBC (won't fix, duplicate, unclear, or out of scope).

intake_metadata.description: Raw one-line feedback plus normalized signal, likely type, and candidate highest-leverage question.

behavior_note.description: The Behavior Note stored in the wrkq task description.

pre_interview_analysis.description: Agent analysis of what can be inferred from available context, what remains uncertain, whether clarification is needed, and the single recommended question/default if needed.

clarification_response.description: The product-owner answer to the single clarification question.

pbc_draft.description: The draft PBC stored in the wrkq task specification.

pressure_pass.description: The compact pressure pass verdict, tighten list, and patch.

patch_decision.description: Product-owner decision after a pressure pass requests a patch.

pbc_final.description: The finalized PBC stored in the wrkq task specification.

disposition_decision.description: Reason this feedback is closed without a finalized PBC.

clarification_response.description: Blocking wait for the product owner to answer the one clarification question.

patch_decision.description: Blocking wait for the product owner to accept, adjust, reject, or waive the pressure patch.

transitions.description: Normalize the raw one-line feedback into a Behavior Note, capturing the normalized signal, likely type, and candidate clarification question.

outcomes.description: Feedback was normalized; advance to the Behavior Note state.

transitions.description: Pre-interview analysis flagged that clarification is needed; raise the single highest-leverage question and wait for the product owner.

outcomes.description: Clarification is required; move to the waiting state and open a blocking obligation on the product owner.

obligations.reason: Answer the Behavior Note open question or accept the default recommendation.

transitions.description: Enough is known without clarification; draft the compact PBC directly from the Behavior Note.

outcomes.description: PBC was drafted; advance to the draft state ready for a pressure pass.

transitions.description: The product owner answered the clarification (or accepted the default); record it and proceed to drafting the PBC.

outcomes.description: Clarification satisfied; advance to the draft state.

transitions.description: Run the compact pressure pass against the draft PBC to produce a verdict, tighten list, and patch.

outcomes.description: Pressure pass started; advance to the pressure state where its verdict routes the next step.

transitions.description: Pressure pass returned a ready verdict; finalize the PBC and close the task as finalized.

outcomes.description: PBC accepted; transition to the terminal finalized state.

transitions.description: Pressure pass requested a patch; route to the product owner to accept, adjust, reject, or waive it.

outcomes.description: A patch decision is required; move to the waiting state and open a blocking obligation on the product owner.

obligations.reason: Accept, adjust, reject, or waive the pressure-pass patch.

transitions.description: Pressure pass judged the PBC too vague; send it back to drafting without a product-owner decision.

outcomes.description: PBC needs more work; send it back to the draft state for another iteration.

transitions.description: Product owner chose to finalize after reviewing the pressure patch; finalize the PBC and close the task.

outcomes.description: PBC accepted; transition to the terminal finalized state.

transitions.description: Product owner chose revision after reviewing the pressure patch; send the PBC back to drafting.

outcomes.description: PBC needs more work; send it back to the draft state for another iteration.

transitions.description: Dispose the feedback directly from the Behavior Note state when a disposition decision closes it without a PBC.

outcomes.description: Feedback closed without a finalized PBC; transition to the terminal disposed state.

transitions.description: Dispose the feedback from the draft state when a disposition decision closes it without finalizing the PBC.

outcomes.description: Feedback closed without a finalized PBC; transition to the terminal disposed state.

transitions.description: Dispose the feedback from the pressure state when a disposition decision closes it instead of patching or finalizing.

outcomes.description: Feedback closed without a finalized PBC; transition to the terminal disposed state.
